name: od-visual-regression
description: OD Visual Regression の最小限の WordPress 開発環境

scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-visual-regression wp i18n make-pot . languages/od-visual-regression.pot --domain=od-visual-regression --exclude=node_modules,vendor
scripts.i18n:mo: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-visual-regression wp i18n make-mo languages
